title: Challenger findings 1.0.0 - what the cross-model challenger returns
description: The challenger audits the chairman's draft as an investment judgment - is the thesis judged right at this price. It is not a compliance auditor and it never authors a verdict: no field here can carry one, and the endorsement channel only names the highest rating it would support. The three echo fields bind the response to the exact case file sent.

run_id_echo.description: The run_id printed in the case file header, echoed back verbatim.

nonce_echo.description: The one-time token printed in the case file header, echoed back verbatim.

casefile_sha256_echo.description: The case-file hash printed in the case file header, echoed back verbatim.

authored_verdict.description: Always false: the challenger audits, it never authors.

findings.description: Every finding against the draft, each one self-contained.

endorsement.description: Optional typed endorsement: the highest rating on the owner's five-word scale this challenger would support on this record. Null when no endorsement is issued.

summary.description: The challenger's overall view of the draft, in plain CIO-suitable English.
